newsitem.title: UK: BZW HIRES THREE ANALYSTS IN LONDON.
newsitem.headline: BZW HIRES THREE ANALYSTS IN LONDON.

text.p: BZW, the investment banking arm of Barclays Plc, said on Thursday it had hired three analysts to cover the transport, oil and electricals sectors.
Nick Ward will join the firm to cover transport from early September. He will leave NatWest Securities to take up his new job, BZW said.
Keith Watson, who has just completed a round-the-world yacht race, will join BZW to cover electronics and support services.
The third new hire is Susan Scott, who will join BZW from Credit Lyonnais Securities. She will be part of the oil team and cover European integrated oil stocks.
The appointments follow three recent hires by BZW in its banking and insurance team.
BZW has seen a higher-than-usual turnover in staff over the past year after the appointment of Bill Harrison as chief executive and a string of outside hirings and internal changes.
